notes.content:
Certain stages have received graphical improvements mainly from better use of color. These stages are:

Example:

notes.title: Balkadia Update: Making the game a bit easier & adding a new map screen!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who purchased Balkadia!

Some very good feedback was received regarding the difficulty of the game. After some tweaks, Balkadia is much more forgiving:
[list]
[*] some enemy/boss attacks are slower
[*] some enemy/boss health points are reduced
[*] the player's health is now doubled
[*] better jump control in the air (gif below)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36742029/e19857ae794279c936b14c5a6d230dce67c39f46.gif[/img]

Also, there is a much better map screen now, the old one was admittedly very ugly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36742029/44662df37bb2a401a17eedf9290610efa8cf9616.gif[/img]

Balkadia's demo will be updated in a few hours as well to reflect these changes. Thank you for your time!

Sincerely,
George from TRG
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36742029/27e3847e77a002bae884690926036d88d0574e77.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36742029/97e3800adfe830fb4b7fbcd8060af831dfe67a80.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Balkadia Release - April 28th 2022
notes.content:
After 3 years of development, Balkadia is finally ready for release. It will be releasing two weeks from now, on April 28th (Thursday). If you haven't played the demo, now would be the perfect time to try out the first 3 stages of Balkadia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36742029/233a8a30aa0bfed3b11ffeaad33c39980992d0c3.gif[/img]

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
A classicvania, featuring 8-directional whipping and giant bosses with multiple forms. The whip is versatile enough to serve as a shield, cut through enemies and use them as projectiles. Fluid controls will help you overcome any platforming challenge. Not a metroidvania.

[b]Playtime:[/b]
The full game consists of 15 levels, each different from the next. While you can speedrun Balkadia in about 90 minutes, this won't be possible on your first playthrough. There are also 15 achievements included and optional upgrades which make replaying older stages fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36742029/b22b1a16a335f3b8775e003c16378cb87a925ef2.png[/img]

[b]Some technical details:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]ultrawide friendly[/u]: Balkadia supports 21:9 and 32:9 monitors
[*] [u]retro friendly[/u]: Balkadia supports 4:3 and 5:4 monitors
[*] [u]4K ready[/u]: all graphics were designed with 4K in mind, then scaled down for lower resolutions
[*] [u]controller support[/u]: Balkadia works with any controller detected by your OS, but requires a keyboard for the initial configuration
[/list]
Again, it's probably best to play the demo first, at the bottom of Balkadia's main page you can find more information which will help you make an informed decision.

Thank you for the time and your support!

notes.title: Balkadia Demo Fully Released
notes.content:
Development of 'Balkadia' began on December 30th 2018. Now that the first 3 stages are finally developed, it is time to release a playable demo on Steam.

[h1]Stage 1[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36742029/233a8a30aa0bfed3b11ffeaad33c39980992d0c3.gif[/img]
Stage 1 is all about attacking - no platforming challenges yet.

[h1]Stage 2[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36742029/76e604614bfd635f0160108e97cf822582c7e8b5.gif[/img]
Stage 2 is the opposite - no attacking, just platforming challenges.

[h1]Stage 3[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36742029/73c1cf3f0c39c880f1d2839bf9951865535a9579.gif[/img]
Stage 3 finally combines platforming challenges and combat. It also introduced the healing mechanic. Why is it black and white? It is inspired by an episode from Samurai Jack called 'Jack vs. the Ninja'. Look it up.

[h1]Tutorial Stage[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36742029/d033835a5442a4a82fe1fc79f64df943ac8a6145.gif[/img]
Before you can play the stages, you need to pass a short tutorial - usually takes a minute. It teaches you a lot about the controls of the game:
- 8-directional whipping
- sprinting
- shooting projectiles from the whip
- throwing objects with the whip
- using the whip as a shield

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36742029/8551e7923b064edc97f10bfca98fba5d959c1292.gif[/img]
Looking forward to feedback from the community! Below you can wishlist the game and play the demo.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236180
